McDelivery Bait-and-Switch Violates CPA.
If you use McDelivery and care about which kitchen prepares your food, watch out. This app charges a mandatory "service fee," yet the service provided is entirely deceptive. 
I manually selected a clean, well-managed restaurant to prepare my delivery. The app explicitly confirmed that chosen store right up until the transaction was finished. Under Section 219 of Quebec's Consumer Protection Act (CPA), it is strictly illegal to make misleading representations about a service.
